description: This file contains functions for managing network interfaces and obtaining network configuration details using ubus and jsonfilter in OpenWrt. It includes functions to retrieve IP addresses, subnets, gateways, DNS servers, and interface status, designed for scripting network setup or diagnostics.

methods.name: __network_ifstatus
methods.description: Internal function to fetch interface status or configuration data, with caching.

methods.name: network_get_ipaddr
methods.description: Retrieve first IPv4 address of a specified interface.

methods.name: network_get_ipaddr6
methods.description: Retrieve first IPv6 address or prefix of a specified interface, with fallback options.

methods.name: network_get_subnet
methods.description: Retrieve the IPv4 subnet for an interface.

methods.name: network_get_subnet6
methods.description: Retrieve the IPv6 subnet for an interface, excluding link-local addresses.

methods.name: network_get_prefix6
methods.description: Retrieve the IPv6 prefix of an interface.

methods.name: network_get_prefix_assignment6
methods.description: Retrieve the IPv6 prefix assignment of an interface.

methods.name: network_get_ipaddrs
methods.description: Retrieve all IPv4 addresses of an interface.

methods.name: network_get_ipaddrs6
methods.description: Retrieve all IPv6 addresses and prefix assignments of an interface.

methods.name: network_get_ipaddrs_all
methods.description: Retrieve all IPv4 and IPv6 addresses of an interface.

methods.name: network_get_subnets
methods.description: Retrieve all IPv4 subnets of an interface.

methods.name: network_get_subnets6
methods.description: Retrieve all IPv6 subnets of an interface.

methods.name: network_get_prefixes6
methods.description: Retrieve all IPv6 prefixes of an interface.

methods.name: network_get_prefix_assignments6
methods.description: Retrieve all IPv6 prefix assignments of an interface.

methods.name: network_get_gateway
methods.description: Retrieve the IPv4 gateway for an interface.

methods.name: network_get_gateway6
methods.description: Retrieve the IPv6 gateway for an interface.

methods.name: network_get_dnsserver
methods.description: Retrieve DNS servers configured for an interface.

methods.name: network_get_dnssearch
methods.description: Retrieve DNS search domains for an interface.

methods.name: network_find_wan
methods.description: Identify the interface holding the default IPv4 route.

methods.name: network_find_wan6
methods.description: Identify the interface holding the default IPv6 route.

methods.name: network_is_up
methods.description: Check if a given interface is active/up.

methods.name: network_get_protocol
methods.description: Get the protocol type of an interface.

methods.name: network_get_uptime
methods.description: Get the uptime of an interface.

methods.name: network_get_metric
methods.description: Get the metric value of an interface.

methods.name: network_get_device
methods.description: Get the Layer 3 device associated with an interface.

methods.name: network_get_physdev
methods.description: Get the physical device underlying an interface.

methods.name: network_defer_device
methods.description: Defer actions on a network device.

methods.name: network_ready_device
methods.description: Resume actions on a network device.

methods.name: network_flush_cache
methods.description: Clear internal cache to force re-reading network data.
